name: minecraft-mcp
description: Control your Minecraft client with JsMacros scripts, screenshots and player takeover. Includes the MCP server and companion Skill.

interface.shortDescription: Play and inspect your local Minecraft client
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Minecraft MCP client mod. Run JsMacros scripts, read incremental output, capture the game view and report progress in local chat. The player can take over with /mcp stop. Requires a local Minecraft instance with the companion mod and JsMacros, plus Node.js 22 or later. Baritone is recommended but optional.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Minecraft client and show me what is happening.
Help me gather resources in Minecraft, with progress updates.
